research.notes: Entity number and legal name come from a third-party mirror of California Secretary of State data (bizprofile.net), not bizfileonline directly. The contact page names the firm 'Shah Kawasaki - Architects'. profile.summary: An architecture firm based in Oakland, California, founded in 1999. It designs buildings and spaces for public-sector clients such as fire departments, school districts, cities, police departments and parks and recreation departments.
